subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding and calculating a percentage discount
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student applies a virtual 'sale sign' percent-off to an item's price and finds the new price
exercise.pictorial: Student shades a bar model to show the discounted portion vs the amount paid
exercise.abstract: Student calculates the discount amount and final price given an original price and percent off

misconception_flags: calculates the discount amount but forgets to subtract it from the original price

interest_binding: exercise generated using student's stated interest profile (e.g. discounts on items related to their interests)
